## Upcoming

### Lunch & Launch: Build Your Python Project Portfolio with Quarto

November 13 | PyLadies Boston | Virtual

Got a free hour at lunch (ET)? Spend it building your Python project portfolio! As part of PyLadies Boston's Grab a Byte series, we'll set up a portfolio, add your projects, and publish it for the world to see. We'll use Quarto, a tool for creating polished, reproducible outputs with Markdown and Python. [Register here](https://www.meetup.com/pyladies-boston/events/315992566/?eventOrigin=group_events_list).

### Deploying and sharing open source data projects on Posit Connect Cloud

November 17 | R en Buenos Aires | Virtual

Curious about Posit Connect Cloud, Posit's new platform for publishing and sharing Quarto docs, Shiny apps, and more? Join Alex Chisholm and me to explore why easy deployment matters, what the upcoming migration from shinyapps.io looks like, and how to deploy your own work in a few quick demos. [Register here](https://www.meetup.com/rbuenosaires/events/317245969/).

### Working with Weights and Sampling Designs for Official Statistics

November 18 | uRos 2026 | Paris, France

This short, hands-on tutorial will get you started in tidy survey analysis in R using the {srvyr} package. We will use motivating examples from the European Social Survey to introduce survey design objects, descriptive analysis, and data dissemination. Learn more about [uRos 2026](https://r-project.ro/conference2026.html).

### From Python to Publication: Create Beautiful, Reproducible Reports with Quarto

December 3 | PyLadies San Francisco | Virtual

Come build a small data report from scratch with Python, Markdown, and Quarto, and see how quickly your analysis can become a polished, shareable document. [Register here](https://luma.com/tjil83jq).

### Automating Python data science reports with Quarto

December 9 | PyData Global | Virtual

Turn your Python scripts and notebooks into dynamic, reproducible documents with Quarto! If you haven't made it to an earlier session, this is the last one of 2026. [Register for PyData Global](https://pydata.org/global2026/tickets).
